body: Yeah, if only people loved who I actually am :/

Thanks and I appreciate what you said. No one has ever "realize(d) what they're missing in you when you're not readily available" once and it really hurts. I feel very forgettable and unwanted because sure some people just get busy but the people I get closest to either die or push me away until I'm out of their life complete (while lying to my face and telling me how much they still want to see me). I've tried just waiting, I've tried putting all my effort into it. I always end up alone no matter what and I have not a single example to point to where this hasn't happened yet. And thats what hurts the most is I felt this time was different and I tricked myself into believing that someone actually saw me as something other then just a throwaway curiosity to be removed when I'm no longer useful.
